LAW AND MOTION 301, DEMURRER TO COMPLAINT, SUSTAINED IN PART AND OVERRULLED IN PART.APPEARANCES: JOHN ELSBREE, ESQ., APPEARED ON BEHALF OF DEFENDANTS AND MOVING PARTIES HOKE MING LEE AND OI LAU FUNG. SIU L. MA, ESQ., APPEARED ON BEHALF OF PLAINTIFFS AND OPPOSING PARTIES KIN KEUNG LI AND NGAR LUN YUEN LI. THE COURT RULED ON DEFENDANT YOKE MING LEE'S DEMURRER TO COMPLAINT. THE FIRST CAUSE OF ACTION (VIOLATION OF RENT ORDINANCE) IS OVERRULED. THE SECOND CAUSE OF ACTION (INTENTIONAL INFLICTION OF EMOTIONAL DISTRESS) IS SUSTAINED WITH TEN(10) DAYS LEAVE TO AMEND. THE THIRD CAUSE OF ACTION (BREACH OF COVENANT OF QUIET ENJOYMENT) IS OVERRULED. THE FOURTH CAUSE OF ACTION (NEGLIGENCE) IS OVERRULED. THE FIFTH CAUSE OF ACTION (RETALIATORY EVICTION) IS SUSTAINED WITH 10 DAYS LEAVE TO AMEND. THE SIXTH CAUSE OF ACTION (NUISANCE) IS SUSTAINED WITHOUT LEAVE TO AMEND. THE SEVENTH CAUSE OF ACTION (WILLFUL DESTRUCTION OF PERSONAL PROPERTY) OVERRULED. PREVAILING PARTY TO PREPARE ORDER. JUDGE: JAMES J. MCBRIDE REPORTER: ERIC THRONE, CSR # 7855
